definitions.ask: Should a terminal agent's never-publishable outbox rows leave the live queue 14 days after it finishes, instead of 90?
definitions.why: The required fixes bound the job on their own, without changing what users see locally

choices.label: No visible change; sase's queue still levels off near 30,600 rows that reconcile must overlay
Hot queue shrinks ~6x, reconcile gets faster; read-only agents' reads leave local view at 14 days
